description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release renders inline math more reliably, fixes duplicated terminal output in remote workspaces, makes the execution timeline easier to read, and updates five agents.
New
- ZCode supports /rename to rename the current session, and the conversation title in codeg updates to match unless you have already renamed the conversation yourself.
- OpenCode's reserved space before automatic compaction can be set as a share of the context window, such as 20%, as well as a token count.
Improved
- Resumed delegations appear as delegation rows in the execution timeline, marked as resumed and showing the reason for resuming.
- Read and search steps inside explore groups use the same layout as command rows, and the secondary text of non-text steps has higher contrast.
- Updated OpenCode to 2.2.5, CodeBuddy to 2.179.2, Kimi Code to 2.4.1, Antigravity to 1.4.5 and the ZCode bridge to 0.82.0.
- Kimi Code can read text files up to 16 MiB, so files larger than 2 MiB no longer fail to load.
Fixed
- Single-dollar inline formulas such as $T$ now render as math, while amounts, shell variables and code stay exactly as written. (#1081, @xy3xy3)
- Opening another window in a remote workspace no longer duplicates terminal output, including the window for importing local conversations. (#1085, @xyalter)
- Background command and image generation cards in OpenCode history now show their final results and no longer stay stuck as running.
Note
- OpenCode's /goal, /init and /review commands currently show no progress after you send them, and the session can stop responding if a step needs your approval.
- OpenCode's background command and image generation results appear after you reopen the conversation, not while they are still running.
